type:
∀ (δ : ℝ) (n m : ℕ),
  Roth.eta δ m + 2 * (1 + 3 * δ) * ↑n * √↑m < ↑m / 2 ↔ Roth.eta δ m < Roth.gam δ n m
what: The numerical small-delta inequality (30) is equivalent to eta being smaller than gamma.
how: Unfold gamma and lambda, distribute division over subtraction, and collect the scalar factor: half of the lambda term is the error term in (30).
hypotheses: No sign, nonzero-dimension, or degree assumptions: delta is any real and n,m are arbitrary naturals.
caller_summary: Unused in MainLemma; two body occurrences in Main.exists_delta (241) and Main.roth_of_isIntegral (560); both full proofs replayed with inline arithmetic and original signatures.
mathlib_api_audit: lt_sub_iff_add_lt is the canonical additive order law. sub_div/div_sub_div_same and mul_div_cancel_left₀ give the normalized scalar version; the exact old spelling also needs coefficient and association normalization.
moral_duplications: The exact eta formula has no role in the equivalence. Morally a translated strict inequality; exists_delta_bound supplies a substantive numerical bound rather than this equivalence.
generalization: Verified arbitrary e:ℝ in place of eta and arbitrary a,b,c in a Field K with LinearOrder K and IsStrictOrderedRing K: a + 2*b < c/2 ↔ a < (c-4*b)/2. This is a new generic proof, not an existing mathlib declaration; the underlying additive law already holds for AddGroup G, LT G, AddRightStrictMono G.
